learning_outcomes.text: Their knowledge and understanding of the main areas of Mechanical Engineering
The ability to know the potential of product development techniques and major mechanical manufacturing technologies
Their critical and constructive spirit, their ability to identify problems and to imagine and study solutions

syllabus_topics: The major themes of Mechanical Engineering: Energy, Automatic Systems, Productive Systems, Biomechanics and Experimental Mechanics, Automotive Industry, Ocean Engineering and other topics related with Engineering
Sustainability; global warming; Industrial Revolutions and role of Engineering; Informatics Revolution and Education: on the way to a society of knowledge?
Manufacturing technologies: Additive Manufacturing, Casting, Machining, Metal Forming, Joining
Metrology and its application to Mechanical Engineering
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 90% from the final exam (Test) and 10% from participation in proposed activities (Written work). Eligibility for exams requires attendance in 75% of scheduled classes. Special assessment involves an examination on the entire subject and participation in all assessment activities. Classification improvement is subject to Faculty rules.
